notes.title: The night of Walpurgis is upon us…
notes.content:
PLEASE NOTE: “The Ballad” is currently only available in Russian! We are currently working on the English translation and will make it available as soon as possible.

https://sun9-13.userapi.com/impg/_KifjLJa3wi-3oZnzjsFnGHdQlaWXzveYeugqQ/lFulHjHKDWQ.jpg?size=2560x1162&quality=95&sign=7545ba8dbb60ed61ff37bb062e0efdfe&type=album
The first paid DLC for Young Hearts, “The Ballad of Blood, Mist, and Darkness,” will be available today!
The update also includes some bug fixes for some of the previously released routes.
